document.abstract: Gevacolor Positive Type 9.54 film is a new color print film, designed primarily to provide improved definition. Dye stability has also been increased. The structure of the film, the image quality and sensitometric characteristics are compared with the former type. The relation between light scattering within the emulsion, and definition, is discussed. Sharpness and grain of the new filmstock are given in terms of modulation transfer functions and Wiener spectra, respectively. The spectral sensitivity curves, exposure requirements, processing formulas and procedures are presented.
